title: D5 fix round 1: read the real planner_usage.json shape, planner as a pool-wide footer not a per-goal column, other bucket so totals are complete, per-goal planner runs rendered, test hygiene (from review T-0191)
spec:
Fix round for T-0186 (branch task/T-0186 at 38d91fe). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0186. Review T-0191 (opus) requested changes; items come from it. Scope: orchestrator/scorecard.py, orchestrator/cli.py, tests/test_scorecard.py, README.md.

1 HIGH scorecard.py (≈line 195): planner_usage.json is written by pool._save_planner_account as {acct_id: {"window_tokens", "day_tokens", "offsets"}}; read "day_tokens" (sum over accounts), never "planner_day_tokens". Build the test fixture with pool._save_planner_account (or that literal shape) so the assertion touches production data.

2 HIGH scorecard.py (≈line 226): the planner transcript tally is pool-wide and resets daily, so it must not be a per-goal percent column. Remove planner tokens from the per-goal rows; print ONE footer line under the --by goal table: "planner (transcripts, today): <tokens> tokens across <n> accounts" or "planner: -" when the file is missing. Per goal, the planner column shows only that goal's decision runs from planner_runs.json: count and, when the records carry usd, their sum; "-" when planner_runs.json is missing, "0 runs" when the file exists but has none for that goal (distinguishable from missing).

3 MED scorecard.py (≈line 217): tasks with roles outside the four buckets (challenge, triage, anything else) go into an "other" bucket; total_usd sums every child task's usd. Test: a goal with a 2.0 execute and a 5.0 challenge reports total 7.0 and other 71%.

4 LOW format_planner_cell (or its replacement) returns str in every path; tests restore sys.argv with addCleanup and assert at least one numeric cell value in the --by goal output, not just the header and column count.

5 README.md: the "Run it" line for --by goal describes the footer and the per-goal runs column.

No new dependency. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: Planner transcript tokens are read from day_tokens per account and shown once as a footer; a fixture in the real pool shape yields the right figure (test)
Per-goal planner column shows decision runs from planner_runs.json with - / 0 runs / n runs distinguished (test)
An other bucket exists and total_usd covers every child task; the 2.0 + 5.0 fixture reports 7.0 (test)
format helper returns str in every path; sys.argv restored via addCleanup; a numeric cell asserted
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; only the four scoped files change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Clean working tree, committed on `task/T-0194`.

## Summary

Fixed all 5 items from the opus review (T-0191) for T-0186's `--by goal` scorecard feature:

1. **`_planner_usage_totals`** now reads `day_tokens` (the real field `pool._save_planner_account` writes to `planner_usage.json`), never the nonexistent `planner_day_tokens`. Test fixture uses the real pool save function.
2. Planner transcript tokens moved out of per-goal percent columns into a single footer line: `planner (transcripts, today): <tokens> tokens across <n> accounts` or `planner: -`. Per-goal `planner_runs` column now shows that goal's own decision-run count (+ usd sum when present) from `planner_runs.json`, distinguishing `-` (file missing) from `0 runs` (file exists, none for goal) from `<n> runs`.
3. Added an `other` bucket (`ALL_BUCKETS`) so any role outside execute/review/spec_review/scout (challenge, triage, etc.) is counted, and `total_usd` sums every child task.
4. `format_planner_runs_cell` (replacing `format_planner_cell`) returns `str` in every path; `test_default_output_unchanged` now uses `addCleanup` for `sys.argv`; new CLI-level test asserts a real numeric cell value in `--by goal` output.
5. README's "Run it" section rewritten to describe the footer line and per-goal runs column.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/scorecard.py`, `orchestrator/cli.py`, `tests/test_scorecard.py`, `README.md` (only the four scoped files).

**Test output:** `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → `Ran 243 tests in 33.651s — OK` (no failures).
